prompt:

Asset type: one finished wide landscape artwork for the Discord bot feature Review Credit, in a coordinated premium 3D product artwork series.
Input image: supplied Voice Keeper artwork is a STYLE AND CHARACTER REFERENCE, not the subject to reproduce. Change the feature imagery completely.

New composition: centered friendly floating ceramic bot head, WITHOUT ANY HEADPHONES. The bot hovers above the lavender translucent circular platform. Two smaller translucent lavender speech bubbles arc behind the main review bubble, one with a crisp raised checkmark and one with a small warm gold star pictogram, suggesting reviews acknowledged and credited. Arrange the three review bubbles as a clear compact flowing cluster, no overlap obscuring the bot's face. A fine elegant lavender curved connector between bubbles and platform suggests automatic collection; keep it very restrained. Bot head to center-right, main heart review bubble to center-left, unified balanced sculptural still life. The platform front must display a crisp instantly recognizable actual white Discord Clyde logo on a round blurple enamel badge, visibly large enough to read at thumbnail scale. Retain one tiny green status indicator beside the badge.
Style/medium: exceptionally polished luxury CGI product campaign illustration; realistic porcelain ceramic, brushed silver trim, translucent refractive lavender glass; carefully controlled specular highlights, soft ray-traced shadows, soft broad studio lighting from upper left, gentle lilac rim glow. Colors white, silver, Discord blurple #5865F2 and soft lavender, coral pink heart and a small warm gold star as accents. Airy seamless white-to-very-pale-lavender backdrop and softly reflective matte floor.
Composition/framing: landscape 16:9 about 1672x940 or higher. Strong thumbnail-readable silhouette, all essential elements fully visible within central 80%, generous breathing room, upper-left corner quiet for website badge, no typography column. Match the provided reference's composition scale and refined visual character.
Constraints: absolutely NO text, letters, digits, labels, counters, UI screenshots, wordmarks, watermark or card frame. Symbols and Discord Clyde emblem only. One bot, three speech bubbles, one glass platform, one Discord badge. No headphones, microphones, speakers, sound waves, servers, coins, banknotes, wallets, credit cards or financial imagery. No people, hands, robot limbs. No visual clutter or excessive neon. Render the actual finished artwork, not a website mockup.
